meta.defaultTitle: Vela Hotel — Boutique hotel in Galata, Istanbul
meta.defaultDescription: Vela Hotel is a 24-room boutique hotel in Galata, Beyoğlu, Istanbul. Set in an 1890 building, a 250-metre walk from Galata Tower.

hero.title: A quiet threshold in the middle of the city
hero.lead: At the top of Serdar-ı Ekrem Street, inside an apartment building whose façade was never touched. Close the door and Istanbul's hum stays outside.

positioning.statement: {name} is a {rooms}-room boutique hotel in {neighborhood}, {city}, set in a building dating from {year}.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.lead: Three room types, {total} rooms in total. None is a copy of another; the building's own geometry left a different plan on every floor.

experience.title: In the hotel and around it

breakfast.title: Breakfast
breakfast.body: On the terrace floor, 07:30 to 10:30. Cheese and olives come weekly from Kadıköy; the bread arrives every morning from the bakery below the street.

terrace.title: Terrace
terrace.body: On the roof, open from late afternoon. It faces the Golden Horn and the far shore; after six the light turns the whole façade orange.

neighborhood.title: Neighbourhood
neighborhood.body: {neighborhood} was built to be walked. Step out and turn right: the street takes you down between design shops and old apartment doors.

location.title: How far is what
location.lead: {street} is one of the steepest and quietest streets in Galata. Every distance below is on foot.

one.quote: The stairs were hard on the first day, then they became the best part of it.
one.author: Elif K.

two.quote: You can see the tower from the window. We never closed the curtain.
two.author: Tomas W.

three.quote: In a place with twenty-four rooms, the person at reception knows your name by the second day.
three.author: Merve A.

footer.demoNotice: This site is a portfolio piece built for a fictional hotel. Vela Hotel is not a real business; the address, phone number, rates and guest reviews are sample data.
